name: How can a garage remodel add value to my home?

mainEntity.name: How can a garage remodel add value to my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: A garage remodel can add significant value to your home by increasing usable living space and enhancing functionality. Converting an unused garage into a habitable room, such as an additional bedroom, home office, or an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU), directly increases your property's square footage and potential rental income. Even basic remodels that improve insulation, add storage, or update aesthetics can boost curb appeal and make your home more attractive to potential buyers. The return on investment for garage conversions, especially ADUs, can be substantial in high-demand real estate markets like the Bay Area.
acceptedAnswer.description: A garage remodel adds value by increasing usable living space, like an ADU or home office, and improving functionality, which can boost property value and rental income.
